body:
Fixed the 4 lib-0/lib-1 CI test failures on PR #2924 and pushed commit e727963d1c883e081c3350bebd28e6a6ec90c42c to origin/claude/story-1917-slice3 (no force):
1. resolve_aida_exe_tests::no_cli_source_outside_the_resolver_uses_raw_current_executable_lookup: replaced std::env::current_exe().unwrap() in story_1917_dispatch_exec_tests.rs with crate::resolve_aida_exe().
2. task_1915_mandate_ship_failure_ledger_tests::no_question_mark_exit_between_the_mandate_release_and_the_merge & every_exit_between_the_mandate_release_and_the_merge_ledgers_a_refusal: moved the pre-release dispatch_ctx.reverify_now(true)? check immediately before  (before any hold is touched) so there is no  exit in the post-release window.
3. story_1698_mandate_tests::every_failure_after_a_mandate_release_re_arms_the_hold: unified the post-release dispatch_ctx.reverify_now(true) check into the single post-release mandate lapse check in pr_cmd.rs so it re-arms any mandate-released hold via rearm_after_mandate_failure and ledgers the refusal via ledger_mandate_ship_failure.

Verified green:
- cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib 'resolve_aida_exe_tests::no_cli_source_outside_the_resolver_uses_raw_current_executable_lookup' -> 1 passed
- cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib 'task_1915_mandate_ship_failure_ledger_tests::' -> 8 passed
- cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib 'story_1698_mandate_tests::every_failure_after_a_mandate_release_re_arms_the_hold' -> 1 passed
- cargo test -p aida-cli-lib --lib 'task_2344_q1_physical_tick_lock_directory_migration_and_legacy_mutator_refusal' -> 1 passed
- make check-ci-fast -> 35/35 gates passed.
subject: PR #2924 @ e727963d1c: fixed 4 lib-0/lib-1 CI failures and pushed
